column1: # HOST SPIKES -- disabled, because the benchmark cannot see them.
# The four salmon proteins this file used to list could never have been
# scored. `cmd_benchmark` builds its record set from config["species"], which
# is lsal and crog; salmon is config["host"] and has no cascaded.json. So a
# salmon accession here matches no record, contributes no row, and
# negative_control_report returns passed=False on an empty list.
# Making them work needs a spike-in: the named salmon proteins appended to the
# louse proteome for a benchmark run, as tests/test_cli_end_to_end.py does
# synthetically. That is a workflow change, not an id change, so these stay
# off until it exists. Until then the cross-reactivity filter is unverified by
# the negative controls -- it is still exercised by the cascade itself, but
# nothing here proves it rejects what it should.
# SSAL_ACTB  host_spike  host_similarity  Salmon beta-actin
# SSAL_TUBA  host_spike  host_similarity  Salmon alpha-tubulin
# SSAL_GAPDH host_spike  host_similarity  Salmon GAPDH
# SSAL_HSP70 host_spike  host_similarity  Salmon HSP70; highly conserved
